projects.title: Chickens!!!
projects.description:
One of my favorite things about moving home to Tennessee was raising chickens for the first time.  So many varieties and egg colors. Enjoy this simulation of the wonderful world of chicken farming! There are still a lot of bugs and cheats.  Sometimes one of your chickens will auction itself off, or get two auction pay offs. And everyone's favorite, "The amazing Half Chick". Why does it happen??  O_O
Chickens are drawn to food, but if it's not fast enough for you, pick your chicken up and wipe it around on the food, lol.  It will grow really fast.  Try not to overload the game with too much food at once.

Concept, artwork and programming by @Scrappymammy
Music is Smokey Mountains and Barn Music from Audioblocks

This idea stemmed from a comment I received on my "Music To My Ears" noteblock compilation back in April. Someone suggested that I create a project where I add noteblock songs created by other users. I reached out to @Foxies4Ever, and we began brainstorming possible themes. We decided upon "Film Scores and Show Tunes", so all the songs featured in this are from movies and musicals.

projects.title: Random Path Octagon Grid
projects.description:
An unusual but interesting method to draw an octagon grid with Pen.  Idea and algorithm by me.

Two fancier projects of this type:
https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/730692074/
https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/730821303/

A Turtle Graphics project.

Huge thanks to @PinkyPepper for the Turtle picture:  https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/86634161/
projects.instructions:
The Turtle draws an Octagon Grid via a Random Path.
Idea and rules for valid turns to draw path by me.

* Run at normal speed.  The path is random, so you can use Turbo Mode to finish drawing the grid quickly.

The turtle repeatedly draws a line then makes a valid turn randomly.  The selection of valid turns depend on the direction that the turtle is currently moving.
If the turtle is moving diagonally, it may randomly turn 45 or -45 degrees.
If the turtle is moving vertically or horizontally it may randomly turn 45 degrees in the current turn direction, or turn 90 degrees in the opposite direction.

If a line goes off the screen, the turtle reverses direction and retraces the line (and also reverses the turn direction).

v0.1: Initial release.
v0.2: Had to get rid of the "Cloud Zombies Killed" because it didn't work for some reason.
v0.3: Added fast zombies and tank zombies. Also money, but it doesn't do anything yet ;)
projects.instructions:
COMPUTER: Use up and down arrow keys or W and S to move up and down. Space to yeet grapes.
MOBILE: Click up or down in the direction you want to move. Click the duck to throw grapes.
REGULAR ZOMBIES: Green ones, hit them with grapes, don't let them past you or touch you.
TANK ZOMBIES: Same as regular, but red, and you have to hit them 3 times.
FAST ZOMBIES: Very fast, small, and blue. Ok if they past but will reduce your score and spawn more zombies.

STORY: You are human's last line of defense against zombies, and you are... A DUCK!

projects.instructions:
Make or generate a custom planet, and have fun!
~~~~~~~Controls~~~~~~~
Click 'n Drag - Spin Planet
U - Save
I - Load
O - Load Preset (By name - Supported celestial bodies are below)
Note: You have to triple click the save then copy to copy it correctly.
Q - Open/Close Editor (Computer)
Click Planet - Open/Close Editor (Mobile)
G - Rename Planet (Up to 20 Characters)
Up/Down Arrows - Raise/Lower Water
Left/Right Arrows - Raise/Lower Temperature
8 - New Planet
~~~~~Terrain Editing~~~~~
Z - Raise
X - Lower
C - Noise
V - Flatten
B - Smooth Raise
N - Smooth Lower
T - Show Pen Size
M - Smooth Entire Planet
~~~~~~~~Moons~~~~~~~~
Y - Toggle Moons
J - Toggle Moons Orbiting
P - Open/Close Moon Editor (Computer)
Click Bottom Right - Open/Close Moon Editor (Mobile)
L - Add Moon
0 - Delete Moon In Editor
9 - Change Moon Editor View
~~~~Sides 'n Rotations~~~~
4 - Change Cloud Direction
E - Change Planet Spin Direction
S - Swap Sun Side
6 - Change Separated Clouds Type
~~~~~~~~Toggles~~~~~~~~
F - Toggle Dynamic Biomes
H - Toggle Planet Name Visibility
Space - Toggle Clouds
1 - Toggle Water Visibility
2 - Toggle Vegetation Visibility
3 - Toggle Shadow Visibility
5 - Toggle Cloud Movement
W - Toggle Planet Spin
R - Toggle Nerd Stats
D - Toggle Rings
A - Toggle Height Only
7 - Toggle Heatmap
K - Toggle Map View

Note: If you have the planet and clouds going in opposite directions it looks a bit weird depending on the cloud speed.
Note: After loading in a save, you might have to double click a toggle button.
Note: you can use the brushes in the moon editor!

Default values for things are (For an Earth-like planet):
Water Level - 50
Grass Color - 0
Water Color - 0
Shadow - 1.5
Cloud Speed - 7
Spin Speed - 3
Temperature °F - 75
Cloud Density - 2
Orographic Barrier - 2
Planet Size - 4
Air Thickness - 2
Air Color - 0
Air Transparency - 80
Ground Saturation - 0
Rings would be off, but ring defaults would be
Ring Density - 4
Ring Spread - 1
Moons - On
Star - Yellow
Distance from Star - 6
Don't let these stop you from making your own planet though. (:

Funny thing I noticed is that if you have Clouds at 10 speed, and planet at 5 speed, and you have them going in opposite directions, then if you time it right, the clouds look like they aren't moving.

  Note: Gas giants are faked because there isn't support for those yet.

Current Presets:
Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Makemake, Ceres and Kepler-22b.

What is this game?
This is an endless platformer with randomly generated levels. There may be some impossible levels that may be solved with some power-ups.
The theme of this game is forest

Power-ups
There are some power-ups scattered in the levels. Find them and store them. PS- They last for only 30 seconds after you enable them. Some power-ups you may find are:
i) Parachute- Press space to glide safely down
ii) Energy drink- Makes you faster
iii) Gravity potion- Decreases gravity
iv) Skateboard- Helps you to jump higher
To enable the power-ups, click on the top-right button and select the power-up you want to use by clicking on 'enable'.

Other information:
You can wall jump
There may be glitches. To wall jump, instead of pressing the up button continuously, press it and let go many times. This decreases the chance to glitch out of a wall.
Also, if you touch the brown parts, your vision gets low.

projects.title: Spelling Bee
projects.description:
The Spelling Bee shows no mercy. The Spelling Bee takes no prisoners. Do not fail the Spelling Bee. 
___________________________________________

Instructions:
Volume and spelling ability is required for this project!

Spell as many words as you can to avoid the wrath of the Spelling Bee and bring honor upon your hive, all before the time runs out.

In the top right of the screen there are buttons to return to the menu and to clear what you have typed. 

If you need a word repeated, click the bee.
___________________________________________

This started out just as a silly pun but I like how it ended up. Sure there's not much to it, but I think it's a cute little side project. This is a project I started in January or February of 2022, but I first had the idea further back.

Fun fact, in the fifth grade spelling bee, I made it to 10th place and then lost because I had never heard of the word "princely". Perhaps this project is my 11 year old self getting some of that salt out. 

There's a part of me that worries about accessibility with this project, but at the same time, if I offered a visual option that would go against the whole point of it. I'm really sorry if your ability to enjoy this project is hindered by its reliance on sound. 
___________________________________________

projects.title: From Earth to Mars
projects.description:
If you go inside the project and look at the costumes for the rocket sprite, you will notice something interesting. In fact, the fact that I said "costumes" plural tells you something already. I originally made the rocket look like the Saturn V, since I didn't know what kind of rocket goes to Mars. I kept the costume because it was really good, and later I may add the option to choose between a mission to Mars or the Moon. For now, its just there.
____________________________________________
Mission to the Moon is now out! It's still just a one-way trip, but that could be changed if you guys want!
https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/881025986
projects.instructions:
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
OMG FEATURED 8/7/2023!!!!!!!!!!!!!! TYSM ST!!!!!!
I dreamed this would happen but never really expected it! I am replying to all the comments except those that say a compliment (I still read them and thank you for your compliment, but there are just too many to reply to!), that are talking to others, and that are advertising. I just got back home from a trip, logged in to do something and also check my email and scratch, and found like, 640 messages or something! I have no clue how this happened, but thank you to whoever made this happen!
___________________________________________
PLEASE No advertising! They will be deleted! This is overwhelming as is, and I don't need more stuff!
Fixed the play button and it now says "several months" instead of "a few days" That's all for now, but I can add more stages eventually.
____________________________________________
This is for Scratch Camp 2023 Week 2 Mission to Mars
____________________________________________
I decided to create an animation from Scratch Camp this week. This is strange, because I usually do art or games. An animation was something I hadn't ever done before, at least not a full one, meant to be watched for a few minutes, rather than a few seconds, as an intro, or part of a game.. But I did it, and now I present to you my first animation ever, From Earth to Mars.
Watch as a rocket takes off for Mars with a new NASA rover inside. It travels through space for a few days (it would really be years) and lands.
Some parts are narrated by text-to-speech blocks, like the countdown. You constantly hear the rocket, and the wind at the beginning and end.
I had more ideas than I could code, like showing the control room and the place where the rocket would have been built before the countdown, and more talking at first. I also had hoped to show the rocket in different stages, but I wasn't able to. If I were to make a moon and mars version, you would not see the Saturn V's 3 stages and other maneuvers. Beyond that, everything should be pretty accurate.
Thanks for watching, and I hope you like it!
____________________________________________
